title: Electric Herb Grinder COMPACT for Flower Buds, USB-Rechargeable, 2pcs 1.7oz Glass Herb Chamber - Ideal for Everyday Carry
description:
About this item
Unmatched Grinding Experience: This innovative grinder, featuring a toothed grinding disc, finely shreds your herbs into light, fluffy fibers, ensuring perfect consistency every time. Unlike regular grinders, it doesn't reduce spices to powder.
Powerful Performance: Built-in 1100mAh rechargeable battery, enough power for weeks of use. Now you can easily process herbs into even, fluffy granules in 1 minute - much faster and simpler than manual grinding. Even sticky herbs can be easily ground.
Automatic Grinding: No need to hold a button - the pre-set 35-second automatic grinding cycle ensures optimal consistency and prevents over-grinding. The best alternative to manual grinders.
Energizing & Creative: The Spacenight Electric Herb Grinder is designed for convenience and efficiency, featuring a compact yet durable build. Equipped with a high-speed motor, 304 stainless steel grinding disc, a safety switch, and durable glass jar, it ensures a seamless grinding experience.
Important Notes: Not suitable for hard spices like pepper or cinnamon. Backed by a 12-month warranty. Kit Includes 1 electric herb grinder, 2 glass jars, 2 plastic pop-top storage bottles, and a cleaning brush.

reviews_5s: Purchased this grinder on Sep 6, 2024. Have used it everyday since. Grind at least a grinder full daily. I put it on the charger for first time today, May 15, 2025. Have to say I am super impressed with purchase to say the least. Just have to figure out the process, but works great!The glass jars for grinding seem to break easily, and you cant buy just the container. Other than thta it is a great little unit for grinding my favorite herbThis is a well-designed product. It is easy to use and cuts down on the amount of product. It is simple to clean.👍Love itHas good power , still need to remove branches, hard little nugs may need reground , but all in all good toolComes ready to useI bought this as a gift for my fiancée to help her grind her flower. She has arthritis and traditional grinders are very difficult for her to use when she is inflamed. This device made a huge difference for her. Very easy to use, very sensitive button, easy to clean, lightweight, and much quieter than expected. Consistent grind with minimal effort.I think this thing is great. Actually I have two. I liked it so much I got a second one. Everything I put in there comes out with a really nice fine grind to it. It is a little tricky turning it on. I don't know why I have such a hard time with it, because everytime it starts up I say to myself. "Well, that was easy". Of course right now I forget how to do it, but I digress. I had a different grinder before I purchased this and I hated it. It was bigger than this and had a bigger motor, but no matter how may times I used it everything came out chunky, and it was messy. This one I hardly get anything falling out if it when I open it. You just turn it upside down and everything falls into the jar. No muss, no fussPerfect
